confidence_notes: General-knowledge estimate for July 2026, not based on live menus, listings, or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; July hostel and hotel rates are the least certain because they are seasonal and volatile. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weak. Icelandic menu prices typically include VAT and service, and tipping is not expected. USD values assume an exchange level of roughly 120 to 140 ISK per USD. No web search was used for city prices. The FX observation came from search results restricted to rba.gov.au; the page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other high-cost Nordic capitals such as Oslo and Copenhagen, with restaurant and bar prices placed in a similarly high tier. Accommodation reflects July peak-season demand in a small capital with heavy tourist traffic. Cocktail and wine anchors were derived from the beer anchor at roughly 1.5x and 1.3x.
